Editor reads ⲡ[ⲁⲛⲁⲣ]ⲁⲥ; standard Manichaean cosmic figure who arrives at the cosmic dissolution.

notes.decision: Tentatively rendered 'in death.' ⲧⲙⲟ is unusual; likely Lycopolitan ⲧⲙⲟⲩ ('the death,' fem. of ⲡⲙⲟⲩ) or possibly ⲧⲙⲁ 'the place.' Context — 'doing a great time being established in X, standing fast in their...' — fits the death/abyss into which First Man descended. The companion phrase ⲉϩⲧⲁϩⲥ̄ ('being fixed/anointed') with ⲉϩⲧⲏⲕ ⲁⲣⲉⲧϥ̄ ('standing fast') suggests cosmological captivity within the dark realm.

Translated 'battle' on the assumption that this is a continuation across line-break (line 7 ⲁ- + line 8 ⲡⲁⲧⲱⲛ → ⲁⲡⲁⲧⲱⲛ) of a battle/contest noun, parallel to ⲡⲁⲣⲱⲛ in accumulated vocabulary. Could alternatively be a different form. The cosmic battle (πόλεμος/ἀγών) of First Man fits the context.

Translated 'that shine forth.' Reading as ⲉⲧ-ⲡⲓⲉ-ⲱⲩ from the verbal root ⲡⲓⲉ 'shine, radiate' (already in glossary as the root of ⲡⲡⲣⲓ̈ⲉ 'the Radiance'). Applied to the Five Gods who are sons. Alternative reading 'that are great' (= ⲡⲱⲟⲩ) is also possible.

Translated 'delay much.' ⲣ̄-ⲉⲥⲕⲉ from ⲱⲥⲕ 'tarry, delay'; ϩⲁⲧ likely intensifier 'much, long.' The ϯ- forms are unusual — possibly errors for ⲛ̄- or definite article. Context (in the First Man) supports temporal delay of the Five Gods within him.

Tentatively parsed 'she sent her.' The verb ⲟⲩⲱⲣⲥ̄ (= ⲟⲩⲱⲣⲡ 'send') with prefix; the sequence ⲛ̄ⲧⲁⲥ-ⲟⲩⲣ-ⲟⲩⲱⲣⲥ̄ would mean 'when she sent her' or similar. The line establishes that the Mother of Life was sent down by the Father — fits Manichaean cosmology of her cosmic descent.

Translated 'the place of the Twelve Aeons.' ⲙⲁⲛ̄ⲧⲥⲛⲁⲩⲥ̄ = 'place of the twelfth/twelve' — the next line continues with [ⲛⲁⲩ]ⲥ̄ confirming -ⲥⲛⲁⲩⲥ̄ 'twelve.' The Twelve Aeons hidden behind the veil of light is a standard Manichaean cosmological grouping.
Translated 'glance of the eye.' ϩⲣⲁⲡⲣⲉⲡ likely = ϣⲣⲁⲡⲣⲉⲡ 'twinkle, blink' (cf. Sah. ⲣⲡⲉ-ⲣⲡⲉ); ⲃⲉⲗ = ⲃⲁⲗ 'eye.' The biblical idiom 'in the twinkling of an eye' (1 Cor 15:52) fits.
